scope: Pre-recovery workflow snapshot; findings describe main before the session-89 repairs are pushed.

root_causes.summary: The only deployment-named GitHub Actions workflow does not deploy to any host. It is a manual local-first guard with one read-only job and no host, registry, environment, artifact, SSH, or rollout step.
evidence: .github/workflows/deploy.yml:3-4 exposes only workflow_dispatch, so pushes do not trigger it.
.github/workflows/deploy.yml:9-23 defines only the Confirm deployment remains local-first guard job.
.github/workflows/deploy.yml:22 explicitly reports that production deployment is intentionally disabled.

root_causes.summary: Every execution of Deployment Guard from the current main tree fails before its report step because Verify deployment docs checks a path that no longer exists.
root_causes.error_summary: test -s docs/DEPLOYMENT.md exits 1 because docs/DEPLOYMENT.md is absent; the tracked document is docs/operational/guides/DEPLOYMENT.md.
evidence: A local execution of the exact command on main at 2f285b532e6fbb0f641532404eebd6b5c586dfbe returned exit 1.
Git history records the docs move in commit 488e6414d8db38f60b12b0ba7fd629eed14be0e0 on 2026-06-13, while deploy.yml still retains the old path.
deploy.yml was introduced by a02d1f193842240b831c2f6838461779a682c5cb on 2026-05-28 and has not been updated for the move.

root_causes.summary: There is no selected always-on host for GitHub Actions to update, so even a corrected workflow has no deployment destination.
evidence: The repository now contains infra/docker/update-central-host.sh for host-side pull-and-recreate operation, but deploy.yml does not invoke a host or identify one.
No host URL, SSH target, self-hosted runner label, container registry publish step, or provider deployment action exists in deploy.yml.

root_causes.summary: The current GitHub Actions workflow cannot provide the persistent storage and continuously running backfill process required by the single-writer polling design; it only starts an ephemeral ubuntu-latest runner for a short guard job.
evidence: .github/workflows/deploy.yml:12 selects ubuntu-latest rather than a persistent central host or self-hosted runner.
The workflow has no persisted volume, service startup, process supervision, health check, or remote update step.

recommended_fixes.action: Stop presenting Deployment Guard as a deployment. Either remove/rename it to Local-first deployment guard, or replace it only after a concrete central host is selected.
recommended_fixes.acceptance: The Actions UI cannot be mistaken for an attempted production deployment.

recommended_fixes.action: Update the docs check and report text from docs/DEPLOYMENT.md to docs/operational/guides/DEPLOYMENT.md, then add a repository test that asserts every workflow-referenced local path exists.
recommended_fixes.acceptance: The exact Verify deployment docs command exits 0 in a clean checkout.

recommended_fixes.action: Select one private always-on Linux host with Docker Compose, persistent disk, outbound provider access, SSH or VPN access, and backups. Keep GitHub-hosted runners out of the polling/data-storage role.
recommended_fixes.acceptance: A named host passes backend/scripts/ops/central_host_preflight.js with .env.central and can run web plus the sole backfill writer.

recommended_fixes.action: After the host exists, choose one update transport: host-initiated pull using the existing update-central-host.sh on a timer is preferred; alternatively use a tightly scoped self-hosted runner or SSH dispatch. Do not put trading or provider secrets in GitHub-hosted jobs.
recommended_fixes.acceptance: A main update fast-forwards a clean host checkout, passes preflight, recreates only web and backfill, and proves health without exposing the service publicly.

recommended_fixes.action: Provide authenticated read-only GitHub Actions access, or export failed run logs, so exact run IDs, timestamps, job URLs, and any independent Test or Build failures can be classified rather than inferred.
recommended_fixes.acceptance: The runs array can be populated from the Actions API with redacted failed-step evidence for each recent failed run.

unknowns.reason: The gh CLI is not installed, no GitHub token or gh configuration is available, and the unauthenticated GitHub Actions API returns 404 for this private or otherwise inaccessible repository.

Without authenticated Actions logs, it is not possible to establish whether the Test and Build workflows also failed remotely or at which exact steps. The local full-suite result does not substitute for runner-specific evidence.
No budget, geographic preference, provider choice, uptime target, storage size, or acceptable maintenance model was supplied, so a specific host cannot be selected from repository evidence alone.
